method: Manual review of every light and dark composite. Each thumbnail fits a 106 x 186 px cell. A defect candidate is inspected at full asset size. The corrected asset is checked at desktop and mobile UI sizes in Chromium and WebKit.
limits: This is an outline and framing review at the stated display sizes. It is not a pixel-by-pixel inspection of all original high-resolution files. Label microtext is not validated.
framing_threshold: Approximate desktop visible height below 130 px with CSS height 176 px and max-width 120 px.
framing_measurement_method: Visible frame uses alpha >= 128 after a proportional 106 x 186 thumbnail. Desktop size uses height 176 px and max-width 120 px. Values are approximate.
